### Fixed
- **model-manager reads a served model's route list on a cluster whose serving slice a GPU node pool brought** (giantswarm/agent-platform#602). `create_node_pool` installs the slice as a second release of the chart, with model-manager off, and the platform release keeps `modelServing` off; model-manager's egress rule into the serving namespace was conditioned on that release's own `modelServing`, so it never rendered and every model served on the pool reported no interfaces. The rule now renders whenever model-manager serves — the slice on, a static kserve backend or cluster-manager on — into this release's serving namespace, else model-manager's `kserve.namespace`. The slice's side is giantswarm/cluster-manager#103.
